system.description:
Standard Power Progression — 2 Basic, 2 Intermediate, 1 Advanced. You must take the levels of a Discipline in order (all Basic before Intermediate, etc.). Powers from other sourcebooks are grouped under "Expanded Options" in the compendium.

  • Basic (2): The Eyes of the Serpent, The Tongue of the Asp
  • Intermediate (2): The Form of the Cobra, The Skin of the Adder
  • Advanced (1): The Heart of Darkness

Base rating-tracker for the Serpentis Discipline. Set the Rating field to your current level in this Discipline, and drag the individual Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Elder powers you've learned from the Disciplines & Powers compendium into the Powers list below it.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
